# GitHub issue templates

This folder is reserved for GitHub issue-form Markdown files.
No issue forms are currently configured in this repository.
If a bug-report or feature-request form is added, place its Markdown file here.
GitHub will display configured forms when a visitor opens a new issue.
Issue forms do not take part in the LaTeX or Python build.
To test a future form, open the repository Issues page and start a new issue.
Keep prompts short and ask only for information needed to reproduce a problem.
Do not ask contributors to post credentials, private manuscripts, or client data.
There are no generated outputs in this folder.
